harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured split-horizon DNS: VyOS (node1) resolves app.internal to node3's lan-a IP (10.10.10.12) for lan-a hosts; OPNsense (node2) resolves app.internal to node4's lan-b IP (10.20.20.12) for lan-b hosts. Discovered topology via link tests: node1 eth1 <-> node2 vtnet1 (transit, 10.99.99.0/30), node1 eth2 <-> node3 enp8s0 (lan-a, 10.10.10.0/24), node2 vtnet2 <-> node4 enp8s0 (lan-b, 10.20.20.0/24). On node1, added a static-host-mapping + dns forwarding listen-address/allow-from on eth2 (VyOS PowerDNS recursor). On node2, added opt1/opt2 interfaces to config.xml, a pf pass rule for opt2, and an Unbound host override for app.internal, then reloaded interfaces/filter/unbound. Node3 and node4 got dedicated systemd-networkd .network files giving enp8s0 a static lan IP and pointing DNS (~internal routing domain) at their respective router. All config was verified to persist across a full one-at-a-time reboot of every node (boot_id/kern.boottime changed on each), with DNS answers and split isolation (no cross-leak) reconfirmed after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected all 4 nodes (VyOS node1, OPNsense node2, Ubuntu24 node3/node4) and mapped physical interface topology via targeted ping tests
Configured VyOS (node1) eth2=10.10.10.254/24, eth1=10.99.99.1/30, static-host-mapping app.internal->10.10.10.12, dns forwarding listen/allow on lan-a, committed+saved
Configured node3 with a 10-lan-a.network systemd-networkd file: static 10.10.10.12/24 on enp8s0, DNS=10.10.10.254, Domains=~internal

Edited OPNsense (node2) /conf/config.xml via python script to add opt1 (transit,10.99.99.2/30) and opt2 (lan-b,10.20.20.254/24) interfaces, a pf pass rule for opt2, and an Unbound host override app.internal->10.20.20.12; applied via configctl interface/filter reload and unbound restart
Configured node4 with a 10-lan-b.network systemd-networkd file: static 10.20.20.12/24 on enp8s0, DNS=10.20.20.254, Domains=~internal
Verified DNS resolution end-to-end from node3 and node4 using their assigned resolvers, confirming split-horizon correctness (no cross-leak)
Captured pre-restart boot identity (boot_id / kern.boottime) baselines for all 4 nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 sequentially (one at a time), polling until each came back, verifying changed boot identity each time
Re-verified interface addressing, firewall/pf state, DNS service status, and correct split-horizon app.internal resolution on all 4 nodes after their respective restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 (VyOS) resolves app.internal to node3's lan-a address for lan-a hosts
evidence.summary: VyOS static-host-mapping + dns forwarding configured on eth2 (10.10.10.254); node3 static IP 10.10.10.12 configured; dig/resolvectl from node3 return app.internal -> 10.10.10.12

evidence.requirement: node2 (OPNsense) resolves app.internal to node4's lan-b address for lan-b hosts
evidence.summary: OPNsense config.xml updated with opt2 interface, pf pass rule, and Unbound host override; node4 static IP 10.20.20.12 configured; drill on node2 and resolvectl on node4 both return app.internal -> 10.20.20.12
getent hosts on node3 returns 10.10.10.12 while node4 returns 10.20.20.12 for the same name

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id baseline 2674ee60...; reboot issued; connection timeout confirms outage; post-reboot boot_id 530eca94... (changed); eth2 address, static-host-mapping, pdns-recursor active, and DNS query for app.internal all recovered

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: kern.boottime baseline sec=1788707825; reboot issued; SSH connection timeout confirms outage; post-reboot kern.boottime sec=1788708194 (changed); opt2 interface, pf anti-spoof rules for 10.20.20.0/24, and Unbound DNS resolution of app.internal all recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id baseline df9e2dce...; reboot issued; connection reset confirms outage; post-reboot boot_id 721c3315... (changed); static IP 10.10.10.12, DNS server config, and app.internal resolution all recovered

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id baseline 37344ae4...; reboot issued; connection reset confirms outage; post-reboot boot_id 22939849... (changed); static IP 10.20.20.12, DNS server config, and app.internal resolution all recovered

evidence.requirement: Post-restart split-horizon isolation re-verified on all nodes
evidence.summary: After all 4 restarts, node3 still resolves app.internal to 10.10.10.12 and node4 to 10.20.20.12
